title: Thursday assorted links
contentHtml:
1. “A whopping 79 NBA players are listed on today’s 2:30 PM injury report for tonight’s games. That’s roughly 15% of the entire league”  This is just week one people!  And some commentary.

2. Video making the case that AI has been fine for jobs.

3. John Repetti reviews The Rouse at Jacobin.

4. Is TikTok now encouraging more optimistic content? (NYT)  Big if true, I am not currently active on the platform and do not have an opinion on the matter.  In any case worth a read.

5. Andy Masley recommends some lesser-known books.

6. New OpenAI dataset on how people use ChatGPT.

7. Piketty-Saez-Zucman biases found earlier by humans.  And an audit from Grok on whether the initial AI report is capturing the major problems.
